readLines: Berlin. Vom 15. bis 17. Dezember 1989 wird in Berlin die 4. Parteikonferenz der SED stattfinden.
Das beschloß das Zentralkomitee am Donnerstag auf seiner 10. Tagung.

Den weiteren Verlauf des zweiten Beratungstages bestimmte die Diskussion, die sich weitgehend auf das Referat des Generalsekretärs des ZK der SED, Egon Krenz, sowie auf den Entwurf des Aktionsprogramms der Partei bezog.
Den Vorschlag, eine Parteikonferenz einzuberufen, hatte im Auftrag der Redaktionskommission der ZK-Tagung Siegfried Lorenz unterbreitet.

voice.text: The party’s paper. One point one million copies.

caption.text: Fourth party conference convened for December. The lead story.

voice.text: It is here. Column seven, below the fold, in the language of a form. Not one word says border.

caption.text: K01, press conference from 18:52:40, not yet provided.

voice.text: He is reading a document he has not read.
Twenty hundred hours. West German television leads with it.
The door is not a photograph. It is a paragraph.
This is what the country read the morning after. A form.
The next day. A photograph. The caption says traffic.

caption.text: Kommunique of the 10th session above. 150,000 comrades at a rally in Berlin. Then, low on the page, heavy traffic at the crossings.

voice.text: Two mornings. The paper of record recorded nothing.

masthead.sub: Organ of the Central Committee of the Socialist Unity Party of Germany

headline.text: 4th Party Conference of the SED convened for 15 to 17 December 1989

lead.text: Berlin. The 4th Party Conference of the SED will take place in Berlin from 15 to 17 December 1989. The Central Committee decided this on Thursday at its 10th session. The further course of the second day of deliberations was determined by the discussion, which related largely to the report of the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the SED, Egon Krenz, and to the draft of the party action programme. The proposal to convene a party conference had been submitted by Siegfried Lorenz on behalf of the editorial commission of the Central Committee session.

regulation.heading: GDR government spokesman on new travel regulations
regulation.text: Berlin (ADN). As the government spokesman announced, the Council of Ministers of the GDR has decided that, until a corresponding legal regulation by the People’s Chamber comes into force, the following provisional rules for private travel and permanent departure from the GDR abroad shall apply with immediate effect: 1. Private trips abroad may be applied for without preconditions (reasons for travel and family relationships). Permits will be issued at short notice. 2. The responsible departments for passport and registration matters of the People’s Police district offices in the GDR are instructed to issue visas for permanent departure without delay. 3. Permanent departures may take place via all border crossing points from the GDR to the FRG and to Berlin (West).

caption11.text: On foot or in a Trabi. Heavy traffic prevailed at the Invalidenstrasse crossing in Berlin (see also page 16). Photo ND/Grahn
